title: TAT-3382 — Perps tab "New" badge (control user flow)
description: Real user-flow proof against the live fixture-backed wallet, no flag patching and no extension reset. This slot's RemoteFeatureFlagController currently resolves perpsTAT3382AbtestTabBadge to the control assignment (background cache; re-buckets only on remote refresh, not on UI reload), so the Perps tab renders in the wallet overview with NO "New" badge. The screenshot proves the Perps tab is present; badge absence is proven by the paired read-only CDP DOM probe recorded in review.md (querySelector('[data-testid=perps-tab-new-badge]') === null), because this runner's ui.wait_for does not honor expected:'absent'. The treatment variant (badge VISIBLE) was also directly observed live via CDP DOM during a treatment window (Perps tab text 'PerpsNew', perps-tab-new-badge present) — see review.md — but could not be re-captured as a recipe screenshot because the flag re-bucketed to control and runtime flag patching is disallowed. AC3 (dismissal/persistence), AC4 (perps unavailable), AC5 (Experiment Viewed exposure) and AC6 (active_ab_tests enrichment) are proven authoritatively by unit tests.
